theme_central: "The best of narratives" (ahsan al-qasas): patience in the face of trial, trust in Allah's plan even in adversity, and final forgiveness.
sources_note: A single continuous narrative, a very widely known and uncontested storyline — no need to cross-check structural sources beyond a direct reading of the text.

branches.title: Opening, the dream
branches.resume: "The best of narratives"; Yusuf's prophetic dream, his father's warning.

children.t: Introduction of the Qur'an, "the best of narratives"
Yusuf's dream (eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing down), Ya'qub's warning

branches.title: The brothers' plot
branches.resume: The brothers' jealousy, Yusuf thrown into the well, sold as a slave in Egypt.

children.t: The brothers' jealousy, Yusuf thrown into the well
False blood on the shirt, Ya'qub's patience
Found by a caravan, sold in Egypt

branches.title: The attempted seduction
branches.resume: At the great chamberlain's house, his wife's attempted seduction, Yusuf chooses prison over sin.

children.t: Al-Aziz's wife attempts to seduce Yusuf, the torn shirt as evidence
The women of the city, Yusuf prefers prison to sin

branches.title: In prison, interpreting dreams
branches.resume: Interpretation of the two fellow prisoners' dreams, then the king's dream.

children.t: In prison, interpreting two fellow prisoners' dreams, a discreet call to Oneness
The king's dream (seven fat and lean cows), interpreted by Yusuf

branches.title: Release, in charge of the granaries
branches.resume: Yusuf publicly cleared, appointed in charge of Egypt's granaries; his brothers come to buy grain.

children.t: Release, publicly cleared, appointed in charge of Egypt's granaries
The brothers come to buy grain, do not recognize him

branches.title: The ruse of the cup
branches.resume: A scheme to keep Benjamin, the brothers' distress, Ya'qub loses his sight from grief, Yusuf finally reveals himself.

children.t: The ruse of the hidden cup to keep Benjamin with him
The brothers' distress, Ya'qub's grief-stricken loss of sight
Yusuf finally reveals himself to his brothers, forgiveness granted

branches.title: Reunion, conclusion
branches.resume: Ya'qub regains his sight, the family reunited in Egypt, fulfilment of the initial dream, lessons drawn.

children.t: Ya'qub regains his sight thanks to Yusuf's shirt, forgiveness sought
Reunion in Egypt, the parents and brothers bow down — fulfilment of the initial dream
Yusuf's supplication, lessons drawn from the story for Prophet Muhammad
